focus: Colombian tax-benefit surface: UVT-schedular personal income tax, health and pension SICs under Ley 100, Familias en Accion, Ingreso Solidario, VAT and the national consumption tax.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Colombia Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: COLMOD
oracles.dataset: GEIH-based input microdata (shipped with the licensed bundle where included)
oracles.role: Household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Colombia. Policy years 2019-25. Report CR-COLMOD-v6.0 (UNU-WIDER).

availability_check.detail: The locally held licensed SOUTHMOD bundle (EUROMOD runtime proven on the Ghana and Rwanda lanes) must be inventoried for COLMOD CO systems before wiring. Validation frame: COLMOD v6.0, policy years 2019-25.
